## Summary

Describe what changed and why it belongs in the durable playbook.

## Change classification

- [ ] Added
- [ ] Changed
- [ ] Superseded
- [ ] Deprecated or retirement announced
- [ ] Needs validation
- [ ] No-action research record

## Evidence

- Evidence label:
- Primary sources:
- Last verified:
- Production impact:
- Affected canonical topics:

## Knowledge lifecycle

- [ ] `catalog.yaml` is updated for new, moved, renamed, deprecated, or superseded content.
- [ ] Weekly research has been promoted into durable guidance only where evidence is sufficient.
- [ ] Canonical pages, ADRs, case studies, and digests have distinct retrieval roles.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated.
- [ ] `DEPRECATIONS.md` is updated when lifecycle status changed.
- [ ] Old guidance links to its replacement instead of being silently deleted.

## Publication and sanitisation

- [ ] No employer or client names are included without explicit publication approval.
- [ ] No internal URLs, tenant IDs, account IDs, document IDs, email addresses, or private repository links are included.
- [ ] No secrets, access tokens, connection strings, private keys, or credentials are included.
- [ ] No raw customer, supplier, invoice, claim, health, or other sensitive records are included.
- [ ] Organisation-specific thresholds and policies are removed or safely generalised.
- [ ] Project metrics are rounded where appropriate.
- [ ] Project evidence is not presented as a universal benchmark.
- [ ] Private-worklog material has completed sanitisation review.

## Technical review

- [ ] Official guidance is separated from project evidence and engineering inference.
- [ ] Fast-changing product, model, SDK, certification, and lifecycle claims were checked against current official sources.
- [ ] Preview, experimental, deprecated, superseded, and unverified content is labelled explicitly.
- [ ] Security, identity, human approval, reliability, evaluation, observability, and cost implications are considered where relevant.
- [ ] Migration and rollback impact is described when behaviour changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `python scripts/validate_content.py` passes locally or in CI.
- [ ] Internal links resolve.
- [ ] The proposed retrieval behaviour is covered by an eval case where appropriate.
- [ ] Remaining uncertainties and follow-up work are listed below.

## Remaining questions or risks

- None, or list unresolved items that a human reviewer must decide.
